answer_1.quote: GPT-4V has astounded the world with its impressively versatile yet practical capabilities, such as generating descriptions, stories, poetry, advertisements, and codes given images...
answer_1.outputs: textual responses (descriptions, answers, stories, poems, code)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the Open-VQA test set... we prompt GPT4 to make it the referee, which achieves a consistency of more than 95% compared with humans. We also report numerical scores on the MME benchmark (accuracy) and Elo rankings.

answer_3.quote: We prompt GPT-4 to act as a referee for Open‑VQA, achieving >95% agreement with humans, and we use a GPT‑4 based Elo ranking evaluator for VisIT‑Bench.

answer_4.quote: We adopt the OwlEval test set... we recruit human annotators to evaluate the performance. Scores range from 1 to 5. The correctness has the highest priority, then the richness of the generated content.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a score from 1 to 5 based on correctness and richness of the response.
